_source: Number of tests of each suite of the four models, collected with `python -m scripts.run_all --update-baseline` (unittest discovery per suite). Regenerate only when tests are added or removed on purpose. Functional: 64 OPP-Split and 63 OPP-Mono (the 37 shared cases plus their own tests), 70 OPP-HC and 71 OPP-ACO (68 per-instance tests plus the tests of their own). Stress: the 19 shared scenarios per model.
